task: Find all small molecules mentioned in PubMed for which gut-wall escape factors affecting oral bioavailability have been experimentally reported, including intestinal efflux transporter substrate behavior, bidirectional transport/efflux ratio, P-gp/ABCB1, BCRP/ABCG2, MRP/ABCC-mediated transport, intestinal CYP/UGT metabolism, enterocyte metabolism, presystemic gut metabolism, or gut-wall extraction.
task_instantiation: Extract experimentally reported gut-wall processes for small molecules or small-molecule classes that can affect oral bioavailability. In scope: intestinal/enterocyte efflux or uptake transporter involvement (especially P-gp/ABCB1, BCRP/ABCG2, MRP/ABCC family), bidirectional intestinal or epithelial transport with Papp/Peff/efflux ratio, intestinal segment permeability/absorption or secretion measured in gut tissue/cells, transporter inhibitor/knockout/defective-animal effects on intestinal transport or oral exposure attributed to gut transport, intestinal CYP/UGT/enterocyte metabolism, presystemic gut metabolism, or gut-wall extraction. Create one record for each primary molecule (or class) × assay/condition × distinct gut-wall result. If a passage reports multiple intestinal segments or multiple treatment conditions with separate values, emit separate records when the values/effects differ; a concentration series in the same assay may be kept in one record with all values in `measured_value`. Extract both qualitative claims (e.g., "is a P-gp substrate", "undergoes intestinal glucuronidation") and quantitative results (Papp, Peff, efflux ratio, Km/Vmax, fold-change, bioavailability/gut extraction values) when experimentally supported or explicitly cited as experimental findings. Skip records where the molecule is only an inhibitor/excipient/test modulator for another drug unless the passage also reports that molecule's own intestinal transport/metabolism. Skip purely parenteral, hepatic-only, renal-only, BBB, tumor-cell, or systemic pharmacokinetic claims unless they are explicitly tied to intestinal/gut-wall first-pass processes after oral administration. Skip non-gut artificial membrane results (e.g., PAMPA) unless the authors explicitly use them to report bidirectional oral-intestinal permeability/efflux relevant to gut-wall escape. Do not infer transporter substrate status solely from an efflux ratio unless the authors state or experimentally demonstrate transporter involvement; numeric efflux/permeability alone is still in scope with transporter_family null. Default context is normal physiological intestinal barrier, wild-type/non-diseased subjects, no inhibitor/excipient pretreatment. Put non-standard conditions that materially change interpretation (transfected cells, knockout/deficient animals, transporter inhibitors, cytokine pretreatment, excipients, disease models, unusual pH manipulations) in `qualifying_conditions`; routine assay details such as species, cell/tissue model, concentration, route, time point, and segment go in the dedicated fields or `extra_details`.

schema_spec.name: molecule_name
schema_spec.description: Surface name of the small molecule or small-molecule class in the passage.

schema_spec.name: gut_wall_process
schema_spec.description: Main gut-wall bioavailability process measured or claimed for this record.

schema_spec.name: transporter_or_enzyme
schema_spec.description: Specific intestinal transporter/enzyme implicated, if stated (e.g., P-gp/ABCB1, BCRP/ABCG2, MRP2/ABCC2, CYP3A, UGT). Null if not stated or not applicable.

schema_spec.name: substrate_status
schema_spec.description: Whether the molecule was reported/demonstrated as a substrate of the named transporter/enzyme. Use null when no substrate/metabolism status is stated.

schema_spec.name: assay_system
schema_spec.description: Experimental system/model used, including species or cell line when stated (e.g., Caco-2 bidirectional transport, rat everted jejunal sac, human jejunal perfusion, intestinal microsomes, oral PK with inhibitor).

schema_spec.name: intestinal_site
schema_spec.description: Intestinal segment or enterocyte location studied, if stated (e.g., duodenum, jejunum, ileum, colon, apical membrane).

schema_spec.name: measured_value
schema_spec.description: Key quantitative value(s) exactly as reported, with units and direction/parameter labels when needed (e.g., Papp A-B/B-A, efflux ratio, Peff, Km/Vmax, percent/fold change, amount transported, bioavailability or extraction). Null for qualitative-only claims.

schema_spec.name: qualifying_conditions
schema_spec.description: Non-standard conditions that materially qualify the claim (e.g., inhibitor/pretreatment/excipient, knockout or transfected model, deficient animal, unusual pH, disease state). Null for control or unspecified standard conditions.

schema_spec.name: extra_details
schema_spec.description: Free-form string for additional details that do not fit other top-level fields.
